paper_title: BICEP / Keck XIV: Improved constraints on axion-like polarization oscillations in the cosmic microwave background
notes: BICEP/Keck XIV (arXiv:2108.03316): search for axion-like CMB polarization oscillations using Keck Array 2012-2015 data. New measured 95%-CL limits on g_phi_gamma for m in 1e-23 to 1e-18 eV, assuming axions constitute all DM (kappa=1, rho0=0.3 GeV/cm^3). Core result (Eq. 16): g < 4.5e-12 GeV^-1 * (m/1e-21 eV) for 1.6e-21 <= m <= 4.8e-20 eV. Data points computed from the paper's smoothed analytic upper-limit formula (Eq. 15, with A0/2=0.26 deg, T0=411 d, m0=1.9e-23 eV) across the full analyzed mass range; points at 1.6e-21 and 4.8e-20 eV use the Eq. 16 constant 4.5e-12. Limits do not exclude previously unexplored parameter space but are an independent direct-detection probe. | selector: text (sole candidate) | axis-peek for confusable-family text read (#625 Phase 3c)
